evidence.title: GitHub - horizon-ui/shadcn-nextjs-boilerplate: Shadcn UI NextJS Boilerplate - Free Open-source ChatGPT UI Admin Dashboard Template - Horizon AI Boilerplate

name: Horizon AI Boilerplate
summary: Open-source Next.js admin dashboard and ChatGPT boilerplate built with shadcn/ui, with 30+ dark/light UI elements.
description: Admin dashboard boilerplate built with Next.js, shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS around a ChatGPT chat interface, for launching ChatGPT-style AI SaaS apps faster. It ships 30+ dark/light UI elements (buttons, inputs, navbars, tabs, cards, alerts) each documented, prebuilt example sections, and a Figma version. A paid PRO version unlocks additional components and pages.
contains: 30+ dark/light UI elements: buttons, inputs, navbars, tabs, cards, alerts
ChatGPT chat interface on the OpenAI API
prebuilt example sections for web projects
PRO version adds components and pages
